name: onceveil
description: Preview-safe, one-time secret sharing with zero-knowledge encryption, MCP support, and self-hosted deployment.

scripts.check: npm run build && npm run check:preview-config && npm run check:generated && npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run lint && npm run format:check
scripts.db:migrate:preview: wrangler d1 migrations apply onceveil-preview --remote --config wrangler.preview-migrations.jsonc
scripts.deploy:production: npm run db:migrate:production && npm run db:mark:production && npm run db:verify:production && wrangler deploy
scripts.deploy:preview: npm run build && npm run check:preview-config && npm run db:migrate:preview && npm run db:mark:preview && npm run db:verify:preview && node scripts/deploy-preview.mjs
scripts.db:verify:preview: node scripts/d1-environment.mjs verify preview onceveil-preview wrangler.preview-migrations.jsonc
scripts.db:mark:preview: node scripts/d1-environment.mjs mark preview onceveil-preview wrangler.preview-migrations.jsonc
